name: cutscene
description: Cinematic cutscene: camera-spline flythrough with cosine easing, letterbox bars, DepthOfField focus, Space to skip

configKeys.waypoints: [{pos={x,y,z}, look={x,y,z}, dur, fov?}] — dur = seconds of travel into the point (default: 3-point orbit around 0,10,0)
configKeys.letterbox: true|false (default true) — black bars tween in/out
configKeys.trigger_bindable: optional ReplicatedStorage child name (BindableEvent or RemoteEvent); unset = auto-play 2s after join. ReplicatedStorage.RbxCutscenePlay always replays
